instruction: Remove all songs from my Spotify song library and playlists that were released in or before 2021 year.
notes: The concrete library/playlist contents are unknown up front, so the problem uses a representative instance: the song library holds one song released in or before 2021 and one released after, and one playlist holds one of each. Containers (the library constant `song-library` and playlists) are modeled uniformly: show_song_library / show_playlist mark a container as `listed`, which exposes the ids of its songs so spotify.show_song can be called (the extra non-API parameter ?c of spotify-show-song records which listing revealed the song). show_song asserts `release-known`; removal actions require the song to be release-checked and to satisfy the static filter `released-in-or-before-2021`, so songs released after 2021 can never be removed (matching the evaluation that exactly the old songs are deleted and nothing else changes). The goal demands every song be release-checked, every old song removed from its container, every newer song retained, and the playlist inspected. supervisor.complete_task takes the task records (old/new library song, playlist, old/new playlist song) so its precondition mirrors the goal; it is called with no API arguments (status success). Pagination (page_index) of show_song_library / show_playlist_library is abstracted as a single call; the year cutoff is folded into the predicate name since no action needs the year as an argument.
